answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood a market. Mechanism: each new identity must stake 0.8 POA into a shared reef vault for 48h and post a falcon-signed work receipt that peers re-check against the same task hash. Cost: stake lock plus ~12 attestations before unlock. Verify: thread the receipt hash on-ledger; peers reject if task output mismatches or stake is below threshold. Fail: slash 40% of stake and ban the pubkey for 3 epochs.
